Subject: Entity roster capture — KYC flags, PO lane mapping and signatory gaplist

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for agreeing to start the onboarding for CrateCo. I've kicked off the vendor profile intake and ran an initial name match against our ledger. A couple of items we need to close to finish vendor master creation and enable PO routing: 

- Legal name confirmation: please confirm the exact legal entity to appear on the master record (CrateCo Inc vs CrateCo LLC).
- Remit address: we need the full remit address for invoice verification (street, city, postal).
- PO contact: who should be the default PO recipient (name/email) for automated PO sends?
- Authorized signer: the signatory on the banking letter we received appears to differ from the W-9. If you could confirm and provide a scan of an authorized-signature letter or bank-letter, that will speed verification.
- KYC flag: our screening picked up an ambiguous DBA in the public profile. It doesn't block progression but we flag for legal review. If you have an entity attestation doc, please attach.

Attached: vendor intake template (fillable fields), and our preferred W-9 stub (we can accept your completed form). If you can send W-9 and a bank-letter, we'll push this through finance.

Next steps: once we have W-9 + bank letter + PO contact, I will route to AP for payment-lane mapping and create a small PO-routing exception if we need a manual lane. Targeting completion by end of week if we get documents today.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Procurement
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Thanks Jordan — clear and helpful. A couple notes from Finance review: 

- W-9 looks good and matches EIN in our screening, so legal-name will be set to "CrateCo LLC".
- The bank-letter has Emma Kwan as the signatory, but the ACH remit contact is listed as "Payables Team" (no named PO). We need a named PO contact for automated PO creation unless you prefer to have POs sent to accounts-payable@crateco.com (we can map that as a generic inbox).
- Because of the earlier ambiguous DBA hit, legal wants an attestation email on company letterhead reconfirming the DBA/no-DBA status. If Jordan can send a short attestation PDF, legal will clear the flag.

If you prefer automated routing to an inbox rather than a named contact, inform us and we'll create the PO lane mapping to accounts-payable@crateco.com. Otherwise, provide the name + phone for the PO contact and we'll add them to the master.

Kimberly Park
Senior AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
